title: Correct current expression
description: Essential: The response must provide the instantaneous current in the form i = I_m sin(ωt) with correct numerical values for I_m and ω.

title: Correct external resistor power
description: Essential: The response must give the power consumed by the external resistor as a numerical value with correct units (W).

title: Correct external force power
description: Essential: The response must give the power of the external forces as a numerical value with correct units (W).

title: Application of Faraday's law
description: Important: The solution should correctly calculate the maximum induced EMF using E_m = n B S ω.

title: Use of circuit Ohm's law
description: Important: The solution should correctly relate maximum current to maximum EMF using I_m = E_m / (R + r).

title: Use of effective current value
description: Important: For power calculations, the solution must use the effective (RMS) current, I = I_m / √2.

title: Correct phase and timing
description: Optional: The sinusoidal function should be sine (not cosine) based on the given initial condition (t=0 when coil plane is perpendicular to B).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: All intermediate calculations should maintain consistent SI units (Tesla, meters, radians/second).

title: Incorrect total resistance
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses only R or only r instead of the total resistance (R+r) in the current or power calculations.

title: Peak vs. RMS confusion
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses the peak current I_m instead of the effective current I when calculating power.
